raw_response:
This plot is not my own land, so I will not spend my little cash on fertilizer or improved seed for it. I will plant cassava stems I kept from last season, clear the bush myself, and weed it twice with help from my children when they are not in school. We do not spray chemicals here, and the rains are enough without any irrigation. I expect to spend about twenty days on this plot from the time I clear it until I dig out the roots.
